notes: DRAFT, and additionally PROVISIONAL. It follows the Government's bill on the 2027 fiscal and customs policy (NU-599-MF-2026), registered in Parliament as bill nr. 326 of 8 September 2026 ('privind simplificarea legislației fiscale și vamale'), passed in first reading on 10 September 2026 and adopted in second reading on 22 October 2026 as Law nr. 247 (parlament.md, read 2026-10-24). Not promulgated: not in Monitorul Oficial up to nr. 524-527 of 23 October 2026, so every value marked `provisional` says what replaces it, and figures may still differ from the law as published. The adopted text (sources, the last entry) was read on 2026-10-24 for the values citing it: the personal exemption 40,020, the major exemption 46,680 and the dependant's 11,040 (art. 33 and 35), the VAT rates of art. 96, peasant farms at 12% with art. 15 lit. c) repealed, 18% profit tax for section K in 2027 (Law 1164/1997 art. 24 alin. (38)), the 12-lei handling fee per imported parcel (art. 92^1), and the gas limit for the 8% rate from 1 April 2027, which is in md-2027.2. The values still citing the bill (dividends, the undistributed-profit regime) were not compared with the adopted text clause by clause. The Government's opinion on the deputies' amendments (approved 15 October 2026, Monitorul Oficial nr. 512-515 of 16 October 2026, part II, aviz 144) and the Economy, Budget and Finance Committee's report for the second and third readings (parlament.md, 21 October 2026) led to the figures adopted. Ends 2027-12-31, as md-2026 ends with its year, so that a set for 2028 is asked for in time (the product's readiness check reads every key 60 days ahead). Every key the product reads for invoices, payments, advances and payroll is here (checked on 2026-10-18 against konta main and the branches books-advances and payroll-timesheets, including payroll-timesheets' leave and sick pay; the cash register's keys of branch cash-register added on 2026-10-22). A value the bill changes cites the bill. A value the bill leaves alone is carried over from md-2026 explicitly, citing the act it stands on, with a note saying so and why; the figures that are reset each year by an act not yet adopted (the CNAM premium in the 2027 fund law, the minimum wage by Government decision) are carried over provisionally and must be replaced when those acts appear. Not encoded from the law: the vice tax, the special VAT regime for distance sales (title III chapter 10, from 1 November 2026), the excise annexes. The June 2026 consultation draft differed; what it alone carried (3% for independent activity, closing new registrations of individual enterprises and peasant farms) was dropped from the bill and removed here on 2026-10-11. Do not file from it. Fixed assets (assets.*, tax.depreciation.*, ledger.assets.*) were added on 2026-10-22 for konta's fixed-assets branch, carried over from md-2026: the bill amends neither Codul fiscal art. 26^1 nor art. 28, and the regulation (HG 704/2019), the catalogue (HG 941/2020), the standard and the chart are not acts it touches.

(5), the supply's date is the invoice's or the payment's, whichever comes first, so VAT is due on an advance received. The bill touches art. 108 only at alin. (9) (art. III pct. 38, banks in liquidation), and the Government's opinion of 15 October 2026 (pct. 43) rejects a deputy's amendment to art. 108 for advances. Read on legis.md as amended by Law 112/2026, 17.10.2026.

ledger.sales.receivable_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts (OMF 119/2013) is not a yearly act and the bill does not touch it. Chapter III: 221 Creanțe comerciale is debited for goods and services sold, in correspondence with 611 and 534.

ledger.sales.revenue_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 611 Venituri din vînzări is credited for sales. The default for an invoice line; a line may name another revenue account or subaccount.

ledger.sales.vat_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 534 Datorii față de buget is credited for VAT charged on sales (subaccount 5344 in the act).

ledger.purchases.payable_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 521 Datorii comerciale curente is credited as goods and services are received and debited as they are paid.

ledger.purchases.vat_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged, and so is the open question. Chapter III prescribes neither choice: holding deductible VAT on 2252 and offsetting it against 5344 is the act's own path; debiting 534 (5344) directly, as the product does, is common practice. To be decided by the compliance owner.

ledger.payments.bank_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 242 Conturi curente în monedă națională, debited for money received and credited for money paid out.

ledger.advances.received_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch vat-advances): the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 523 Avansuri primite curente is credited for advances received and debited when they are settled (5231 from Moldova, 5232 from abroad).

ledger.advances.paid_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch vat-advances): the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 224 Avansuri acordate curente is debited for advances paid and credited when they are settled (2241-2244 by what the advance is for).

ledger.advances.received_vat_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch vat-advances): the chart of accounts is unchanged. Where the VAT due on an advance received waits until the supply: 225 Creanțe ale bugetului (2252, VAT), debited against ledger.sales.vat_account. The act lists the correspondence, not this use of it: usual practice, to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

ledger.payroll.salaries_payable_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Chapter III: 531 Datorii față de personal privind retribuirea muncii, subaccount 5311 Datorii salariale.

ledger.payroll.social_insurance_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Subaccount 5331 Datorii față de bugetul asigurărilor sociale de stat, for the employer's CNAS contribution.

ledger.payroll.medical_insurance_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Subaccount 5332 Datorii față de fondurile asigurării obligatorii de asistență medicală.

ledger.payroll.income_tax_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. Subaccount 5342 Datorii privind impozitul pe venit din salariu.

ledger.payroll.expense_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: the chart of accounts is unchanged. The default expense for a salary and its CNAS contribution, administrative (713); each employee may name their own. A convenience, not a rule of the act.

payroll.income_tax.rate.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: Codul fiscal art. 15 lit. a), 12% of taxable income for individuals. The bill (art. III pct. 4) only adds peasant farms to lit. a) and keeps the rate; no amendment to it is backed in the Government's opinion.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_an.provisional: Law 247/2026 as adopted on 22 October 2026, not yet in Monitorul Oficial: re-read in the law as published.
payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_an.note: CHANGED: Law 247/2026 art. III pct. 10 replaces 29,700 by 40,020 in Codul fiscal art. 33 alin. (1), from 1 January 2027 (art. XVIII alin. (1)), as the bill did (its pct. 9.1). md-2026 has 29,700. Granted monthly as one twelfth (3,335) from the month after the employee asks for it (HG 697/2014 pct. 18), at one place of work only. The same point sets the major exemption (alin. (2)) at 46,680: payroll.income_tax.major_personal_deduction_annual.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_in.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: Codul fiscal art. 33 alin. (1), the exemption belongs to a resident whose annual taxable income is under 360,000. The bill changes only the amount in that paragraph ('cifrele „29700”'), not the cap. Art. 88 alin. (1): the employer need not track the loss of the right. The product's withdrawal of the year's exemption from the month pay here passes the cap is still to be decided by the compliance owner.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_a.provisional: Law 247/2026 as adopted on 22 October 2026, not yet in Monitorul Oficial: re-read in the law as published.
payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_a.note: CHANGED: Law 247/2026 art. III pct. 11 replaces 9,900 by 11,040 in Codul fiscal art. 35 alin. (1) ('La articolul 35 alineatul (1), cifrele „9900” se substituie cu cifrele „11040”'), from 1 January 2027 (art. XVIII alin. (1)). md-2026 has 9,900 (Law 214/2024). The bill as registered did not amend art. 35; the Government's opinion of 15 October 2026 (pct. 11-13) and the committee's report for the second and third readings backed it as the exemption 'pentru copii', and Parliament's press release of 22 October 2026 says 'scutirea pentru copii va crește de la 9 900 de lei la 11 040 de lei'. The text changes the figure in alin. (1), which is the exemption for every dependant (persoană întreținută), not for children only; the higher amount for a dependant with a severe or accentuated disability (payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_disability_annual where carried, 21,780 in md-2026) is not touched. One twelfth is 920.

payroll.income_tax.medical_premium_deduc.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: Codul fiscal art. 35^2 alin. (1), added by Law 212/2023, allows deducting the compulsory health insurance premium paid by individuals. The bill (art. III pct. 10) renames art. 35^2 to cover resident individuals 'care nu desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător', which an employee is, and changes alin. (3); alin. (1) stays.

payroll.income_tax.withholding_method.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: HG 697/2014 pct. 38, as restated by HG 1029/2023, is a Government decision without a term and the bill does not touch it: taxable income and tax are computed cumulatively from the start of the year or from hiring. The open questions in md-2026 (refunds through payroll) stand.

payroll.cnas.employer_rate.provisional: Law 247/2026 as adopted on 22 October 2026, not yet in Monitorul Oficial, and the state social insurance budget law for 2027 (Legea bugetului asigurărilor sociale de stat pe anul 2027), not yet adopted, which may restate it: re-read in both once published.
payroll.cnas.employer_rate.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: Law 489/1999 annex 1 pct. 1.1, 24% for private-sector employers since 2021. The bill (art. VII pct. 2) rewrites pct. 1.1 to 24% for every employer, ending the 29% for budget and public-authority employers, and Law 247/2026 as adopted keeps it (art. VII pct. 2); for the employers the product serves the rate is the same either way. The 2027 social insurance budget law, which could restate it, is not in Parliament yet (bills up to nr. 374 of 9 October 2026 checked).

payroll.cnam.employee_rate.provisional: The law on the compulsory health insurance funds for 2027 (Legea fondurilor asigurării obligatorii de asistență medicală pe anul 2027), once published: its art. 4 alin. (1).
payroll.cnam.employee_rate.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 PROVISIONALLY: the premium is set each year by the fund law, 9.0% for 2026 by Law 321/2025 art. 4 alin. (1). The 2027 fund law is not in Parliament yet (bills up to nr. 374 of 9 October 2026 checked); bill 326 art. XI only drops a reference to art. 89 from Law 1593/2002 art. 3. Replace when the 2027 law is published.

payroll.minimum_wage.monthly.provisional: The Government's decision on the minimum wage from 1 January 2027, usually published in December (HG 771/2025 was published on 18 December 2025).
payroll.minimum_wage.monthly.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 PROVISIONALLY: HG 771/2025 is titled 'pentru anul 2026', but its pct. 1 sets 6,300 'începând cu 1 ianuarie 2026' with no end date, so until a new decision it is the figure in force. The Government sets each year's minimum wage by decision under Law 1432/2000 art. 3, for 2026 in December 2025; the 2027 decision has not been looked for issue by issue. Replace it when published. The product reads this key with TryNumber, so it is optional to it.

payroll.rounding.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: no rounding rule was found in the acts read, and the bill sets none. Bani throughout, half away from zero, is our choice. To be confirmed by the compliance owner.

payroll.rounding_decimals.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: lei and bani, two decimals.

payroll.proration.method.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-proration): a monthly salary for part of a month is the salary times the days worked over the month's working days from calendar/md-holidays.json. Codul muncii art. 128 alin. (1) and art. 97 alin. (3); no act prescribes working days over hours or calendar days, and nothing for 2027 changes that. Our choice, to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

labour.working_time.daily_hours.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-proration): Codul muncii art. 100 alin. (1), 8 hours a day within art. 95 alin. (2)'s 40 a week. The Labour Code is not a yearly act and the bill does not touch it.

labour.working_time.pre_holiday_reductio.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-proration): Codul muncii art. 102 alin. (1), the working day before a non-working public holiday is shorter by at least one hour. The bill does not touch the Labour Code.

payroll.sick.social_contribution.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): bill 326 art. VII amends Law 489/1999 only at art. 49 and annex 1 pct. 1.1, not annex 3. Legea 489/1999 anexa nr. 3 pct. 19: no social contribution is calculated on 'indemnizaţia pentru incapacitate temporară de muncă', whoever pays it. Leave pay is not on the annex's list (pct. 3 even names unused-leave compensation as subject), so it carries the contribution as salary does.

payroll.sick.medical_premium.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): bill 326 art. XI only drops '89,' from the exceptions in Law 1593/2002 art. 3 (art. 89 of the Fiscal Code is repealed by the same bill), leaving art. 20 among them, and its art. III pct. 7 amends art. 20 only at lit. p^2), z^10), z^11), z^18) and z^22), not lit. a). Legea 1593/2002 art. 6 computes the premium on salary and 'alte recompense', which art. 3 defines as any other sum the employer pays its employee except the income of Codul fiscal art. 20, 89, 90 and 90^1. Art. 20 lit. a) exempts social insurance benefits paid from the social insurance budget; the employer's first days are paid from its own means, so the premium applies. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

payroll.sick.income_tax.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): bill 326 art. III pct. 7 amends art. 20 only at lit. p^2), z^10), z^11), z^18) and z^22), not lit. a); art. 18 and art. 36 alin. (8) are not touched. Codul fiscal art. 20 lit. a) leaves out of gross income only social insurance benefits 'achitate din bugetul asigurărilor sociale de stat'; the employer's first days are its own payment to its employee (art. 18 lit. c), o)), which it deducts (art. 36 alin. (8)). So they are taxed with the month's salary. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

payroll.average_earnings.method.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): HG 426/2004 is a Government decision without a term and bill 326 does not touch it; no amendment for 2027 was looked for in the gazette. HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 5 last alineat (as amended by HG 428/2007) and pct. 10: the 3 calendar months before the month of the event (de la data de 1 pînă la data de 1); per working day, the earnings of pct. 3 over the days actually worked, leave, sick days and their pay left out; per calendar day, that times the scheduled working days over the calendar days less art. 111's holidays of the same period. A month with no work stays in the period (pct. 10 last alineat). Somebody employed less than 3 months: the period is the time worked (pct. 5, pct. 11 al. 1). The 12-month period of pct. 5 al. 2 (agriculture, teachers, piece work paid at completion, varying part time) and the seasonal one are not modelled: the product knows only this method.

payroll.average_earnings.reference_month.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): HG 426/2004, not touched by bill 326. HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 5 last alineat: 'ultimele 3 luni calendaristice de lucru premergătoare evenimentului de care depinde plata respectivă (de la data de 1 pînă la data de 1)'. The event is the first day of the leave or of the incapacity.

payroll.average_earnings.lookback_months.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): HG 426/2004, not touched by bill 326. HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 11 al. 2: with no earnings at all in the 3 months, the average comes from 'ultimele 3 luni din cele 12 luni premergătoare evenimentului de plată, în care ei au avut zile efectiv lucrate şi au avut cîştig'.

payroll.average_earnings.calendar_days_p.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): HG 426/2004, not touched by bill 326. If annual leave comes to be counted in working days from 2027 (see payroll.leave.days_basis), the per-day basis of the average may change with it. HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 7: '29,4 zile – numărul mediu de zile calendaristice pe lună'. Used when no earnings exist to average (hired in the month of the event, or none in the 12 months): pct. 11 al. 4 then bases the average on the monthly salary, and pct. 14 subpt. 2) turns a calendar-day average into a month by 29,4, so the product divides the monthly salary by 29,4. That division is our reading of al. 4, for the compliance owner. Pct. 12 also divides periodic bonuses by it; the product does not tell periodic bonuses from monthly ones yet.

payroll.average_earnings.rounding.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): the act is silent and this is our choice; nothing for 2027 changes that. HG 426/2004 says nothing on rounding (the original annex and its nine amending acts read). The averages are kept exact and only the amount paid is rounded, by payroll.rounding. Professional examples (contabilsef.md, 06.12.2010) round the coefficient to 4 decimals and each average to 2, which differs by about 2 bani a leave: question for the compliance owner.

payroll.leave.days_basis.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): Codul muncii art. 113 alin. (1) as in force on 18 October 2026; bill 326 does not touch the Labour Code. WATCH: the Ministry of Labour's draft to count annual leave in working days (22 at least, paid per working day) from 1 January 2027 was not law on 18 October 2026 (reported by the payroll-leave session; the draft was not read here). If it is adopted, this key and the average's per-day basis change for 2027 and this value is wrong from that date. Annual leave is counted, and paid, in calendar days less the non-working public holidays of art. 111 that fall inside it, whatever day of the week they fall on: Codul muncii art. 113 alin. (1); HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 6 subpct. 1) and pct. 14 subpct. 1) pay leave per calendar day 'la numărul zilelor de concediu exprimat în zile calendaristice'. A local patron saint's day (art. 111 alin. (1) lit. j)) is not subtracted: it holds only in its locality. The Ministry of Labour's draft to count leave in working days from 2027 was not law on 18.10.2026.

payroll.leave.pay_month.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): Codul muncii art. 117 alin. (3), not touched by bill 326. Codul muncii art. 117 alin. (3), as consolidated on legis.md (read 18.10.2026): leave pay is paid 'cu cel puțin 3 zile calendaristice înainte de începerea concediului sau la o dată agreată de părți, dar nu mai târziu de data achitării salariului pentru luna în care a fost acordat concediul respectiv'. The whole leave's pay is therefore computed in the payroll of the month the leave starts, including days that fall in the next month, and taxed then (HG 697/2014 pct. 36: when directed to payment). How CNAS splits the contribution by the months the leave covers on IPC21 (Ordin CNAS 31-A/2026 pct. 8.1) is for the IPC21 work. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

payroll.leave.study_share.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): HG 426/2004 pct. 14 subpct. 1), not touched by bill 326. HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 14 subpt. 1), completed by HG 1025/2007: 'În cazul concediilor de studii, rezultatul căpătat se corectează la cota de menținere a salariului mediu – 75 %'.

payroll.sick.employer_days_per_case.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): Bill 326 art. XIII rewords Law 289/2004 only ('se plătesc' becomes 'se finanțează' in art. 4 alin. (2^1), 'plătite' becomes 'finanțate' in art. 13 alin. (3)-(4)) and the Government's opinion on the amendments says nothing on it. Legea 289/2004 art. 4 alin. (2^1) lit. a): 'primele cinci zile calendaristice de incapacitate temporară de muncă se plătesc din mijloacele angajatorului'; from the sixth day the social insurance budget pays (lit. b)), outside the employer's payroll. Not for tuberculosis, AIDS, cancer, a risk of losing a pregnancy or a registered pregnancy, paid by the budget from the first day (alin. (3)), nor for days of unpaid leave (art. 12 alin. (2)).

payroll.sick.employer_days_per_year.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): Bill 326 art. XIII rewords Law 289/2004 only ('se plătesc' becomes 'se finanțează' in art. 4 alin. (2^1), 'plătite' becomes 'finanțate' in art. 13 alin. (3)-(4)) and the Government's opinion on the amendments says nothing on it. Legea 289/2004 art. 4 alin. (2^1) lit. a): 'însă nu mai mult de 15 zile cumulative pe parcursul unui an calendaristic în cazul mai multor perioade de incapacitate temporară de muncă'. The product counts the employer's days of the year in which each incapacity starts.

payroll.sick.employer_share.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch payroll-leave): Bill 326 art. XIII rewords Law 289/2004 only ('se plătesc' becomes 'se finanțează' in art. 4 alin. (2^1), 'plătite' becomes 'finanțate' in art. 13 alin. (3)-(4)) and the Government's opinion on the amendments says nothing on it; the 75% stays. Legea 289/2004 art. 13 alin. (3): 'în proporție de 75% din salariul mediu al angajatului, determinat în modul stabilit de Guvern', with art. 7 alin. (15); HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 14 subpct. 1^1) (HG 685/2019): the calendar-day average of pct. 8 and 10 times the days of incapacity, at most 5, 'recalculat la cota de menținere a salariului mediu al angajatului – 75%'. The insured-income cap of art. 7 alin. (3) concerns the budget's base, not this one.

payroll.income_tax.major_personal_deduct.provisional: Law 247/2026 as adopted on 22 October 2026, not yet in Monitorul Oficial: re-read in the law as published.
payroll.income_tax.major_personal_deduct.note: CHANGED: Law 247/2026 art. III pct. 10 replaces 34,620 by 46,680 in Codul fiscal art. 33 alin. (2), from 1 January 2027 (art. XVIII alin. (1)). The bill as registered (its pct. 9.2) said 40,020, the same figure as the ordinary exemption; the Government's opinion of 15 October 2026 (pct. 10) backed 46,680 and the Economy, Budget and Finance Committee's report for the second and third readings adopted it (Cuiumju's amendment, supported; Cutasevici's 46,650 supported at 46,680), as Parliament voted on 22 October 2026. One twelfth is 3,890. md-2026 has 34,620.

payroll.income_tax.spouse_deduction_annu.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: Codul fiscal art. 34 alin. (2), 21,780 a year since 2025 (Law 214/2024), read on legis.md on 22.10.2026, the same in the version in force on 1 January 2027. Bill 326 as registered does not amend art. 34; two deputies' amendments would raise it (L. Adamciuc to 29,348, L. Iaconi to 25,200), and the Government's opinion and the committee's report of October 2026 support them only for the children's exemption (11,040), so art. 34 stays as it is in the text proposed for the second and third readings. Re-read when the law is published.

ledger.cash.account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. Chapter III, account 241 (the Ministry of Finance's consolidated PDF of OMF 119/2013, SHA-256 0b2271eb4477f8fa4af660a227669629c9162651c99d1f144feb9b6eb64764ab, PDF page 31, read 22.10.2026): 'Contul 241 “Casa” este destinat generalizării informaţiei privind existenţa şi mişcarea numerarului nelegat şi legat în casierie în monedă naţională şi valută străină.' It is debited for cash received 'în corespondenţă cu creditul conturilor: 141, 142, 161, 162, 221, 223, 224, 226, 231, 234, 241, 242, 243, 244, 245, 251, 252, 313, 314, 412, 423, 425, 512, 523, 534, 537, 611, 612, 622, 623, 832 etc.' and credited for cash paid out 'în corespondenţă cu debitul conturilor: 141, 142, 162, 224, 226, 241, 242, 243, 244, 245, 251, 252, 315, 412, 423, 512, 523, 531, 532, 536, 544, 712, 713, 714, 722, 723 etc.' (521, the supplier, is not named for cash paid out, as it is for 242; the list ends in 'etc.'). The account of a cash receipt or payment order and of the cash book; a cash order may name a subaccount the company keeps (2411 Casa în monedă națională).

ledger.cash.accountable_persons_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. Chapter III, account 226 Creanțe ale personalului (the same PDF, page 29, read 22.10.2026): debited 'în corespondenţă cu creditul conturilor: 241, 242, 243, 424, 535, 544, 612, 622 etc.' and credited 'în corespondenţă cu debitul conturilor: 111, 121, 132, 211, 217, 241, 531, 532, 712, 713, 714, 722 etc.'; subaccount 2261 Creanțe ale titularilor de avans (chapter II). Cash given to an accountable person (Law 34/2024 art. 7: for at most 30 days) debits it against the cash account; cash they return credits it.

cash.limits.payments_to_entities_monthly.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. a), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'a) să efectueze, în raport cu alte persoane juridice sau persoane fizice care desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător și/sau profesională în sectorul justiției sau în domeniul sănătății, plăți în numerar în sumă ce nu depășește cumulativ 100000 de lei lunar. Limitarea sumei respective nu se aplică pentru depunerea de numerar în conturile deschise la prestatorii de servicii de plată;' The law does not say whether 'cumulativ' adds up the payments to each recipient or to all of them; read literally, all of them. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.limits.payments_to_individuals_mont.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. b), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'b) să efectueze plăți în numerar în favoarea unei persoane fizice care nu desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător în sumă ce nu depășește cumulativ 100000 de lei lunar, cu excepțiile specificate la lit. c)–h);' The higher or yearly limits of lit. c)-h) (scrap, packaging, farm produce, dividends, loans) are not encoded. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.limits.receipt_from_individual_per_.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. i), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'i) să încaseze plăți în numerar de la o persoană fizică care nu desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător, în sumă ce nu depășește 100000 de lei pentru o plată, cu excepția situațiilor prevăzute la alin. (2) din prezentul articol.' Per payment, not cumulative. Alin. (2) sets 100 000 a year per client for the professions of art. 2 alin. (1) lit. e), not encoded. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.advances.settlement_days_max.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch cash-register): no act read for 2027 changes it, but bill 326 was not searched for amendments to Law 34/2024 or the chart. assets.fixed.value_threshold.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (2): a fixed asset for depreciation in tax purposes is property whose useful life is over a year and whose value exceeds 12000 lei; HG 704/2019 pct. 3 and 4 refer to the same ceiling. The SNC's definition of 'mijloace fixe' takes this fiscal ceiling or the entity's own materiality threshold set in its accounting policies, so in the books it is the default, not a rule: below it an item is a low-value item (SNC Stocuri, not read here), unless the company's policy says otherwise.

assets.fixed.useful_life_over_months.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (2) and HG 704/2019 pct. 4: a period of use of more than one year. The SNC's 'imobilizări' are held for more than a year too. A useful life must exceed this.

assets.depreciation.methods.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. SNC Imobilizări necorporale și corporale pct. 22: 'metoda liniară, metoda unităților de producție, metoda de diminuare a soldului', each described in pct. 23-25; pct. 26: the entity chooses and states it in its accounting policies. The same methods for intangible assets (the section on intangibles refers back to pct. 22-25).

assets.depreciation.diminishing_balance_.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. SNC pct. 25: the diminishing balance method applies a fixed rate that may be increased, under the accounting policies, at most twice the straight-line rate; the increased rate applies to the cost in the first period, to the carrying amount at the end of the previous period after that, and the last period takes the carrying amount down to the residual value.

assets.depreciation.start.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. SNC pct. 28: depreciation is calculated, as the accounting policies say, from the date the asset is put into use or from the first day of the month after; it stops at the date of the end of the useful life or of disposal, or from the first day of the month after. Encoded is the second option, which is also the tax rule (Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (6), HG 704/2019 pct. 13): the month after commissioning is the first month depreciated, and the month of disposal is the last. The first option (from the day itself) is not encoded.

tax.depreciation.method.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (6): depreciation for tax purposes uses the straight-line method, per asset (alin. (5)); alin. (7): the rate is 100% over the useful life set by the Government. HG 704/2019 pct. 12 and 14: computed for the year in proportion to the months in use, A = [(V × Na) / 12] × D. The useful life is the one set in accounting, never under the minimum of the catalogue's interval (HG 941/2020 pct. 9), or the producer's (pct. 13). There are no tax categories with rates any more: the five property categories of the former art. 26 survive only in HG 704/2019's transitional provisions (pct. 39-42).

tax.depreciation.start.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (6) and HG 704/2019 pct. 13: from the month after the one in which the asset is put into use; the last month is that of the end of the useful life, of taking out of use, or of disposal.

tax.depreciation.accelerated_first_year_.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (6^1) lit. a) and HG 704/2019 pct. 16^4: an entity may use accelerated depreciation in the asset's first year of use, up to 50% of its cost; lit. b): later years divide the undepreciated value by the remaining useful life. The first year is 12 consecutive months of the useful life (pct. 16^4, as HG 901/2024 wrote it).

tax.depreciation.accelerated_excluded_ca.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (6^1): accelerated depreciation is not open to financial and insurance/reinsurance activities, section K of CAEM.

tax.depreciation.revaluation_recognised.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Codul fiscal art. 26^1 alin. (15): revaluation and impairment differences of fixed assets are not recognised for tax purposes; the tax value stays the entry value (HG 704/2019 pct. 15-16).

tax.depreciation.unamortised_deductible_.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. HG 704/2019 pct. 36: on a forced disposal or a write-off before the end of the useful life the undepreciated value for tax purposes is not deductible (save up to insurance compensation that is taxable income). On a sale the tax result is the proceeds less the undepreciated value (pct. 33); the undepreciated value is that of the entry value less tax depreciation up to and including the month of disposal (pct. 32).

ledger.assets.tangible.depreciation_acco.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. ledger.assets.intangible.depreciation_ac.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. assets.depreciation.rounding.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. Neither the standard nor HG 704/2019 says how a month's depreciation is rounded; the standard's examples are in whole lei and HG 704/2019 pct. 14 computes the year as [(V x Na) / 12] x D. Each month is rounded to the ban, half away from zero, and the last month of the useful life takes whatever is left down to the residual value, so the total is exact. Our choice, the usual practice: to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

assets.depreciation.rounding_decimals.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. ledger.assets.expense_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. ledger.assets.disposal_income_account.ta.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. ledger.assets.disposal_income_account.in.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026: bill nr. 326 (NU-599-MF-2026, Government text, pages 1-42 read on 2026-10-22) amends no part of Codul fiscal art. 26^1 or 28, and the regulation, the catalogue and the standard are not acts the bill touches. ledger.fx.gain_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch bnm-rates): the chart of accounts and the SNC are unchanged by the bill. Cap. II: subaccount 6226 Venituri din diferențe de curs valutar, under 622 Venituri financiare; cap. III credits 622 in correspondence with the debit of 221, 223, 226, 231, 234, 241, 243, 511, 512, 521, 522 and others. SNC Diferențe de curs valutar și de sumă pct. 14 with pct. 9: a favourable difference from revaluing monetary items is current income, raising cash and receivables or lowering liabilities; SNC Prezentarea situațiilor financiare pct. 161 counts it as financial income. A company may post to its own subaccount of 6226 instead.

ledger.fx.loss_account.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch bnm-rates): the chart of accounts and the SNC are unchanged by the bill. Cap. II: subaccount 7224 Cheltuieli din diferențe de curs valutar, under 722 Cheltuieli financiare; cap. III debits 722 in correspondence with the credit of 221, 223, 226, 231-234, 241-244, 511, 512, 521, 522 and others. SNC Diferențe de curs valutar și de sumă pct. 14 with pct. 10: an unfavourable difference is a current expense, lowering cash and receivables or raising liabilities; SNC Prezentarea situațiilor financiare pct. 161 counts it as a financial expense.

ledger.fx.monetary_accounts.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch bnm-rates): the chart of accounts and the SNC are unchanged by the bill. The accounts (and every subaccount under them) whose balances in a foreign currency are monetary items, kept in lei and in the currency (SNC pct. 6) and revalued at the official BNM rate of the reporting date (pct. 11), which may be every month end by the company's accounting policy (pct. 13). Pct. 4 defines monetary items as assets and liabilities in a foreign currency to be received or paid; pct. 11 names cash, receivables, payables and financial investments, except advances given or received for assets and services (224, 163, 523, left out) and shares and holdings (1411, 1412, 1421, 2511, 2512, 2521, left out). Pct. 12: non-monetary items keep the rate of their first recognition. The list is our reading of the chart against pct. 11, for the compliance owner. Pct. 22: receivables and payables in conventional units between residents (diferențe de sumă) are not revalued; nothing in the books tells them apart yet, so the person posting a revaluation leaves them out.

ledger.fx.rounding.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch bnm-rates): the chart of accounts and the SNC are unchanged by the bill. How the lei equivalent of a foreign-currency amount (amount times the official rate, which BNM sets to four decimals) is rounded, on a line and in a revaluation. The SNC gives no rule: its examples (pct. 9-15, anexa 1) work in whole lei. Bani, half away from zero, as on an invoice line (tax.vat.line_rounding); to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

ledger.fx.rounding_decimals.note: Carried over unchanged from md-2026 (branch bnm-rates): the chart of accounts and the SNC are unchanged by the bill. Lei and bani.

tax.postal_parcel.handling_fee.provisional: Law 247/2026 as adopted on 22 October 2026, not yet in Monitorul Oficial: re-read in the law as published.
tax.postal_parcel.handling_fee.note: Codul fiscal art. 92^1 alin. (1), in the new title II^1 added by Law 247/2026 art. III pct. 29: 'Pentru fiecare trimitere poștală care face obiectul vânzării la distanță de mărfuri importate [...] se aplică o taxă de gestionare în cuantum de 12 lei.' Per parcel, paid by the recipient (alin. (2)), collected by the delivery or postal provider as a condition of handing the parcel over (alin. (3)-(4)) and paid over by the last day of the next month (alin. (5)). In force from 1 January 2027: pct. 29 is not among art. XVIII alin. (1)'s exceptions. The special VAT regime for distance sales of imported goods it refers to (title III chapter 10, pct. 45) starts on 1 November 2026 (art. XVIII alin. (1) lit. d)), and Parliament's press release of 22 October 2026 puts the 12 lei from 1 November too; the text says 1 January 2027, to be confirmed in the law as published. Not read by the product: a company in Konta pays it only as a postal provider, which it does not handle.
